skill.name: meridian-code-review
skill.description: Review a code change in a payment service against Meridian's money rules: amounts as integer minor units (never floating point), an idempotency key on every call that creates a payment, charge or refund, no card data or other PII in logs, and ISO 4217 currency codes. Use when the user asks for a code review, PR or diff feedback, or a pre-merge check on TypeScript or JavaScript code that handles money, payments, refunds or checkout.
